developmental_ablation.pruning_scope: weakest learned readout synapses within each output cell
developmental_ablation.homeostasis: after pruning, scale each output cell's surviving learned synapses back to its pre-pruning total absolute synaptic strength

success_criteria.primary: magnitude_prune_50_homeostatic has higher median free-running byte accuracy than unpruned while teacher-forced median accuracy is no more than 0.01 lower
success_criteria.selection_effect: magnitude pruning exceeds the matched random-pruning condition
success_criteria.homeostasis_effect: homeostatic magnitude pruning exceeds magnitude pruning without homeostasis
success_criteria.claim_limit: this tests synaptic overgrowth-selection-homeostasis, not neurogenesis or a complete human developmental program
